# Data Science & Deep Learning Hub
> Verified directory and real-time knowledge base of online communities for PyTorch, TensorFlow, Kaggle competitions, ML engineers.

## Key Navigation
- [Data Science & Deep Learning Hub Directory Index](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/): Searchable, filterable index of verified communities across Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, and Reddit.
- [About & Curation Standards](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/about.html): 4-tier vetting methodology, anti-spam filters, and quality benchmarks.
- [Submit a Community](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/submit.html): Public submission portal for community admins and creators.
- [Contact & DMCA Removal](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/contact.html): Direct operator inquiries, takedown requests, and partnerships.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/privacy.html): GDPR & CCPA zero-account privacy governance.
- [Terms of Service](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/terms.html): Third-party platform disclaimers and limitation of liability.
- [XML Sitemap](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable URL list and crawling priority directives.
- [RSS Syndication Feed](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/data-science-machine-learning-hub/feed.xml): Real-time syndication feed for newly discovered groups and platform updates.

## Key Facts
- Total Communities: 30+ verified active communities
- Reach & Network: Over 2,100,000 collective members and practitioners
- Access Terms: 100% Free public entry (no paywalls, VIP charges, or token gating)
- Verification SLA: 4-tier check (link liveness, spam moderation, organic velocity, human audit)
- Update Cadence: Continuous 24-hour automated liveness sweeps
- Supported Platforms: Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, Reddit

## Coverage
- Discord Servers: Real-time discussions, voice channels, events, and sub-groups.
- Telegram Channels & Groups: Instant alerts, alpha calls, announcements, and peer chats.
- WhatsApp Groups: Focused cohorts and regional professional networks.
- Reddit Subreddits: Community threads, wiki guides, and discussions.

## Quality & Verification
All listed channels undergo authentication checks, link liveness verification, and member activity monitoring.
